resources.string: Make the strap do things: tap to act, walk away to lock, train by feel.
Double-tap the strap to trigger an action on this device. (The strap exposes a single double-tap gesture.)
Train by feel. The strap buzzes so you don\'t have to watch a screen.
A triple-buzz when you climb into your top zone (Zone 5, ≥ %1$d bpm), a cue to ease off. Max HR comes from Settings.
Also buzz once when your heart rate drops back to Zone 1, a cue that you\'ve recovered.
A gentle wrist buzz when you\'ve been sitting too long, a nudge to get up and move. Inferred from the strap\'s motion on each history sync, so it lags real time by a sync or two.
Buzzes after you\'ve been sitting past your threshold.
Notifications are off, so this can\'t buzz yet. Turn on the master switch in Settings → Notifications to let it through.
Minutes seated before the first nudge.
If you\'re still seated, buzz again this often.
Only nudge during your active hours.
Spots a likely daytime nap from the strap\'s motion and heart rate on each history sync, then asks you to confirm it. Inferred and approximate: NOOP never adds a nap to your sleep without your OK.
When a sync shows a quiet, settled stretch in the day, NOOP offers it here for you to keep or skip.
No naps to review. Detected naps show up here after a history sync.
Quiet and settled, mean HR ~%1$d bpm.
Watches your resting HR, HRV, skin temperature and respiration against your own 28-day baseline. On-device and approximate: informational only, not a diagnosis.
Needs at least 14 days of history. When two or more signals drift together you get a banner on Today and a notification, at most once a day.
A heads-up when the strap battery gets low so you can recharge before bed, and a note when it\'s finished charging.
Notify on low and full battery
Sends a notification when the strap drops to 15% or reaches a full charge, at most once per charge cycle.
An early \"recharge tonight\" heads-up when the strap has about a day of estimated runtime left, at most once per discharge cycle. Turn off to keep only the 15% warning.
Each day uses the time above unless you set a different one here.
Your wake window, the strap wake-alarm, and the evening wind-down reminder, in one place.
A backup alarm is set for %1$s. It fires even if Bluetooth drops, the strap isn\'t worn, or NOOP is closed.
Turn on the smart alarm to wake inside a window you choose.
Wake me with a smart alarm
A guaranteed OS alarm is set for the end of your window; the strap stream can move it earlier if you\'re sleeping lightly.
NOOP doesn\'t have permission to set exact alarms, so your wake isn\'t guaranteed. Tap to allow it in system settings.
The earliest NOOP will wake you.
The guaranteed alarm fires this long after your earliest time.
Also arms your %1$s to buzz at your earliest wake time, so the strap wakes you first and the phone alarm is the guaranteed backup.
Connect your strap to use this. It arms the strap to buzz at your earliest wake time as a gentler first wake-up.
Wake me with a strap buzz

Arms the strap to buzz at your wake time, even if NOOP is closed. Sends the exact alarm command the official app sends, confirmed buzzing on a real WHOOP 4.0. Keep a backup alarm for anything you truly can\'t miss.
Your WHOOP 5/MG won\'t arm this until Experimental mode is on (Settings → Experimental). Right now your wake time is saved but the strap is NOT armed.

Armed on the strap itself with the experimental 5/MG command. A strap-driven wake is still unconfirmed on 5/MG on our side (confirmed only on WHOOP 4.0), so keep a backup alarm for anything you truly can\'t miss.
Connect your strap to arm this; it\'s set on the strap\'s own firmware alarm. Confirmed working on WHOOP 4.0; still experimental on 5.0 and MG. Keep a backup alarm for anything you truly can\'t miss.

Armed on the strap itself, so it can buzz at your wake time even if your phone is asleep or NOOP is closed. Sends the exact alarm command the official app sends, confirmed buzzing on a real WHOOP 4.0. Keep a backup alarm for anything you truly can\'t miss.
A gentle evening notification, timed from your wake time and usual sleep need, so you can settle in time. It\'s a suggestion, not an alarm.

While you\'re inside the window, NOOP watches your live heart rate from the strap. Deep sleep sits near your nightly low and stays steady; when your heart rate lifts above that (a sign you\'re sleeping more lightly or starting to stir), NOOP wakes you a little early so you come up from a lighter phase.

This is a coarse cue from heart rate, not a clinical sleep-stage reading. If the strap isn\'t streaming (Bluetooth off, not worn, app killed), no early wake happens and the guaranteed alarm at the window\'s end still wakes you.

Rename, regroup, or remove an item to tidy your list. Renaming keeps the original question behind the scenes, so a WHOOP import still lines up. Custom items are deleted; built-in ones are hidden and can be restored below.
Logging ahead for tomorrow: today\'s activities inform tomorrow\'s recovery, just as yesterday\'s are reflected in today\'s. Tomorrow\'s answers line up with tomorrow\'s morning.
Answers are about the night and day leading into this morning, the same attribution a WHOOP export uses, so logged and imported days line up.
History stays under the original question so WHOOP imports still line up.
Silent haptic HIIT - the strap buzzes the transitions
Bond your strap on the Live screen to feel the transitions hands-free.
Pause to change work, rest, or rounds.
What\'s new in the app and your data
New release notes and fresh data will land here.
NOOP %1$s is here — tap to read what\'s new.
